notes.title: One Year Anniversary Update Is Coming! And NEW COLLAB!
notes.content:
Hey Voyagers,

[i]Sword of Convallaria[/i] is officially turning ONE!
We’ve come a long way since launch, and this anniversary update is our way of celebrating with all of you who’ve supported the game from day one.

[b][h3]Anniversary Livestream Recap[/h3][/b]

[Watch the full livestream replay here]
https://www.youtube.com/live/hJb2TTu-Thk?si=QPIIGhGA6p1Xwc2X

We recently held a special anniversary livestream to look back and look ahead. Here’s a quick recap of what was shared:

[list]
[*] A nostalgic look back on the journey over the past year, including global milestones and community achievements
[*] Introduction of a powerful new SP version of [b]Inanna[/b]. Now joining the roster with new abilities
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/bae1b5f7080eb50253d0642347b29bb141d4214f.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] First look at the upcoming main story update, “[i]For This World of Peace[/i]”, and a mysterious new character: [b]Rico[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/ad2a32580972a737a39dfac6552eaa1e08d75e97.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/5407d97fb20a06d5cd9189882c0e9063573918e4.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Sneak peek at major system improvements, including tactical optimizations and new progression mechanics
[*] Full breakdown of anniversary events: free summons, login rewards, new expansion in SoD, new encounter events, and more
[*] New cosmetics and bundles, including the SP Inanna skin
[*] A teaser for our upcoming crossover collaboration
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/c07cc0bcbe5adec2b50b55804581e839a3b38c3d.png[/img]

[b][h3]Anniversary Roadmap[/h3][/b]

We’ve also prepared a visual roadmap to help you keep track of everything coming during the anniversary period and what’s just around the corner.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/2c5ed853eca5bb946ce5391fd8d8b49ece9dcc12.png[/img]

Thank you again for an unforgettable year. Here’s to new adventures and even more stories to uncover in Sword of Convallaria! 

For the complete list of event details, updates, and balance changes, please check the full patch notes attached below.



[b][h3]Full Patch Notes[/h3][/b]

[b]▼Update Content
[/b]

1. [Expedition] The brand-new Expedition System is fully implemented.

-  After maintenance on July 30, 2025

[Voyage into Uncharted Waters] Limited-time Expedition system quest event opens.

-  After maintenance on July 30, 2025 – 23:59, August 26, 2025 (UTC-4)

-  After maintenance on July 30, 2025 – 20:59, August 26, 2025 (PDT)

-  After maintenance on July 30, 2025

4. [For This World of Peace] The new expansion is unlocked.

-  09:00, August 1, 2025 (PDT)

-  09:00, August 1, 2025 – 20:59, August 14, 2025 (PDT)



6. [Astral Imprint: Dawnlight] Limited-time summon opens.

-  09:00, August 1, 2025 – 20:59, August 14, 2025 (PDT)

-  After maintenance on July 30, 2025 – 20:59, September 25, 2025 (PDT)



19. [Fresh Start Program] New voyager assistance event is now available.

-  After maintenance on July 30, 2025





▼ Optimization Content



1. [Voyage Momento] The difficulty of completing certain quests has been reduced, while the Voyager EXP and rewards such as Radiant Powder have been increased.



2. [Sail On, Voyager!] The Day 6 login reward has been upgraded from Surprise Popper to Random Legendary Tarot Whisper (Series I), while the total quantity of Surprise Popper remains unchanged.



3. [Shop] The double exchange limit for Hope Luxites has been reset.



4. [Crossing Worlds] The "Skip" feature is now available. Voyagers with Voyager Levels 5 levels or higher than the Stage difficulty can consume Endurance to "Skip" battles and receive 3-star clear rewards.



5. [System] A data statistics module has been added to the post-battle results screen. Voyagers can view information such as characters' DMG dealt, healing performed, and HP lost on the respective page. Additionally, cumulative DMG and total healing during battles will now be displayed.



6. [Chat] A new batch of emoji has been added for voyagers to use.



7. [Shop] The display rules for certain bundle tags have been optimized. Apart from tag adjustments, the specific content and pricing of these bundles remain unchanged.



8. [Event] The return event has been optimized. The activation condition has been adjusted from 60 consecutive days of inactivity to 45 days. Certain quest completion difficulties have been reduced, and some event rewards have been consolidated, maintaining the overall reward quantity. These adjustments will take effect after the maintenance on July 30, 2025. For returning players who have already activated the event before the maintenance, the original event content will remain unchanged and can still be completed. Players activating the Returning Player Event after the maintenance will experience the new version's content.



9. [Localization] Support for Spanish, Portuguese, French, and Italian will be added.

- Release Time: 12:00, August 1, 2025 (UTC-4) / 09:00, August 1, 2025 (PDT)





▼ Bug Fixes



1. [Display] Fixed the simplified description of "Block." "[Buff] When hit by physical attack from the front or the side" has been corrected to "When hit by physical attack from the front or the side"



2. [Display] Resolved an issue where Afra would lack movement animations and teleport directly to the target after casting Tread on Snow post-movement.



3. [Display] Optimized the display logic for Tarot Whisper-related information on voyagers' profile.



4. [Inventory] Fixed an issue where the sorting order for batch enhancement of Tarot Whisper was incorrect in certain circumstances.



5. [Spiral of Destinies] Added recommended beacons for "Bustling Shadows" and "Fragile Peace" in the Destiny Route.



6. [Battle] Fixed an issue where "Act Again" would not trigger after activating "Act After Defeat" and defeating an enemy with One-hit Kill.



7. [Battle] Corrected the description of the "Hunt" skill for Elaman Undying Mask Officers to match its actual effect.



8. [Battle] Fixed an abnormal effect issue with the Aura "Noble Vengeance Prayer" for the Iron Thorn Vengeance Priests in certain cases.



9. [Battle] Resolved an issue where the "Tenacious Will" effect was not functioning correctly.



10. [Battle] Fixed an issue where the trinket "Breath-Concealing Ring" had an abnormal cooldown time.



11. [Text] Enhanced the descriptive text for Casting Mold.



12. [Localization] Fixed certain display issues and translation errors.





▼ Maintenance Compensation

Hope Luxites *300 and Endurance Potion (Time-limited) *1 will be distributed via in-game mail as maintenance compensation.

notes.title: The Evolution of the Sword of Convallaria
notes.content:
Hey Voyagers,

We’re excited to share some updates and plans for Sword of Convallaria with you as we approach our 100-day milestone since the global launch on July 31! Thanks to your incredible support, we’ve reached over 6 million downloads and consistently ranked among top apps worldwide. This journey has been amazing because of you, and we’re grateful for every bit of feedback you’ve shared with us. Here’s a look at what’s new and what’s coming up!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/83d28dee86d541afd951b3b7ea18424cded3411b.png[/img]

[b][h3]In-Game Celebration[/h3][/b]

Starting November 7 (UTC-4), join us for the [b][A Hundred Days of Companionship][/b] sign-in event! Just log in to claim great rewards like Legendary Weapons and Hope Luxites.

We’re also hosting a community event—share your favorite moments or memories from the past 100 days with #SoC100Days on X (formerly Twitter) for a chance to win 300 Hope Luxites!

[b][h3]Upcoming Features and Improvements[/h3][/b]

Over the past few months, we’ve been listening closely to your suggestions. While some changes take time, here’s a sneak peek at what’s on the way:

[list]
[*] [b]More Character Appearances[/b]: Customization is key! Expect new character appearances, with Inanna’s debuting in November. Many more stylish looks are in the works!
[*] [b]Countdown Timer for Events[/b]: Keeping track of in-game events across time zones can be tricky, so we’re adding a countdown timer for all major events, making it easier for you to stay in the action.
[*] [b]Enhanced Story Review[/b]: Revisit your favorite plot points and dialogues with a revamped story review feature, giving you a deeper dive into Sword of Convallaria’s rich narrative.
[*] [b]New Chapters and Events[/b]: Fresh content is on the way! Stay tuned for new chapters in The Fool’s Journey and an upcoming limited-time storyline event with thrilling adventures.
[*] [b]Major Expansion in December[/b]: This holiday season, we’re launching a big update! The Spiral of Destinies will reveal a backstory to the main storyline, filled with new events, character appearances, and special holiday rewards.
[*] [b]Guild Updates and Future Enhancements[/b]: We’re introducing the [[b]Eternum Star Monument[/b]] where guild members can exchange event items for rewards, and we’re exploring new co-op challenges to make guild activities even more fun.
[*] [b]New Progression Systems[/b]: Many of you have been looking forward to the new materials combine system and enhanced progression paths. We’re working on these and can’t wait to share more details in future DEVLOGs.
[*] [b]More Community Events[/b]: Get ready for upcoming fanart events and other ways to showcase your creativity!
[/list]

[b][h3]A Little Gift from Us[/h3][/b]
As a thank-you for being with us, here’s a gift code: [b]SOCDEVLOG4[/b] (Redeem for 300 Hope Luxites).
Sword of Convallaria’s journey has only begun, and we’re thrilled to continue this adventure with you. Keep sharing your ideas with us, and let’s build an even more exciting game world together!

notes.title: New Chapter Drops 9.13!
notes.content:
Greetings Voyagers,

We're thrilled to announce a big content update coming to Sword of Convallaria on September 13th! This update brings new story content for Spiral of Destinies, features, and challenges that will deepen your adventure in the world of Iria. Here's what you can look forward to:

https://youtu.be/jPwmTaHE2V0

[b][h3]New Story Chapter: "Sand-made Scales" [/h3][/b]
Discover the mysterious Elaman Empire, a desert realm renowned for its vibrant commerce, as we introduce the new permanent story chapter "Sand-made Scales." Master the art of trade and governance at your Trade Post and immerse yourself in the intricate dynamics that drive this empire. The beacon "The Other Side of the Scale" will soon ignite, guiding you into the heart of Elaman’s sandy mysteries. Embark on this new adventure and unveil the secrets of a civilization built on the scales of trade.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/0c5b0a285f76288b5108914769bff83c5f025115.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]Exclusive Limited-Time Progression Event [/h3][/b]
Delve into the new storyline within "Spiral of Destinies" from September 13th to November 7th, 2024, and complete designated tasks to unlock a trove of fantastic rewards. Earn Hope Crystals, Random Legendary Gear, Weapon, and Trinket Chests, as well as Time-limited Endurance Potions and Octopus Cans.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/674de97701a2306440601ab5ec151051de815b84.png[/img]
[i]In-development preview of the limited-time Progression Event[/i]

[b][h3]New Assist Function in Spiral of Destinies [/h3][/b]
From September 13th, engage in battles throughout "Spiral of Destinies" with the added ability to deploy characters nurtured in Elysium. This new feature allows for strategic depth, letting you call upon Elysium characters for additional support and tactical advantages on the battlefield.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/5b193807009c7e4778a9534a4b97524f8b973819.gif[/img]

Get ready to explore deeper mysteries and challenges in Sword of Convallaria! Don’t forget to check out these new features and let us know your thoughts.

For more updates and communication, be sure to visit our official community platforms.

notes.title: Unveiling the Next-Generation Pixel Art of Sword of Convallaria
notes.content:
Greetings, Adventurers!

We're excited to share a glimpse into the unique visual style of [i]Sword of Convallaria[/i], a new classic SRPG that merges the charm of retro pixel art with modern advancements.

[h3]Embracing the Past, Innovating for the Future[/h3]

Pixel art, a beloved hallmark of the 8-bit and 16-bit eras, holds a special place in our hearts. Inspired by games like Octopath Traveler, our developers have crafted a visual style that blends nostalgic pixel art with dynamic 3D rendering, creating a unique enhanced pixel art style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/185a244766fee213dc71b796696c8c42cee13500.jpg[/img]
[b][h3]Introducing Next-Gen Pixel Art[/h3][/b]
Our team, with experience from titles like Super Robot Wars and Arc the Lad, is passionate about pixel art. They've created a visual style that honors the golden age of pixel art while pushing its boundaries with modern technology. In [i]Sword of Convallaria[/i], every character is meticulously hand-drawn to ensure perfect pixel alignment and expressive animations. This enhanced pixel art combines traditional pixel art with 3D enhancements, allowing for greater artistic freedom and dynamic visuals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/a799426626d40ee7eaf28ff1434a58584f63fefd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/c9cc4048aec13563e29e1e381ca7f599ae756091.jpg[/img]
[b][h3]Crafting a World of Perfect Pixels[/h3][/b]
Characters in [i]Sword of Convallaria[/i] are categorized into different factions with unique visual elements. Our process involves creating units in a normal style, transforming them into chibi versions, and then meticulously recreating them in pixel art. Idle animations and action sketches are crafted with precision to ensure proportions, movements, and rhythm are spot on before final refinement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/dde771486001681d449c5a849a6a372f0b47181c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/8503963204956e48f7ef2f67c7ed85152c51e122.jpg[/img]
Each pixel in [i]Sword of Convallaria[/i] is a labor of love, aiming for perfection in every frame. This dedication ensures characters are vibrant, dynamic, and true to the essence of classic pixel art, enhanced by modern technology.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/74dcdc788f1e1575cdeb074b30a1adf23646190f.jpg[/img]
If you'd like to learn more about the creation of our enhanced pixel art, feel free to watch the full development chronicle video here.
https://youtu.be/ca3V9EHo5QE?si=A9HOroCqS3epyVfE

Remember to add [i]Sword of Convallaria[/i] to your wishlist to stay updated with our future developments. Join the excitement on [url=https://twitter.com/SwordofConva]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/swordofconvallaria]Discord[/url] to stay in the loop with the latest buzz!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/da71346f06b887a3719b983d18a5699a87419c4c.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]Special Notice[/h3][/b]
The demo on our store page will no longer be available when the official release version is live on July 31 PDT.

notes.title: Meet Faycal: The Watchful Archer
notes.content:
This time we are introducing another member of the Sword of Convallaria mercenary group. 

"I haven't exactly trusted you. Anyway… I'll be keeping an eye on you."
「あんたのことを認めたわけじゃないぞ。と、とにかく……監視は続けさせてもらうからな。」

Faycal (CV: #Yuuto Uemura) 上村祐翔

Faycal is a resolute youth with a shadowed history and one of the initial members of the Sword of Convallaria. As a child, Faycal witnessed the destruction of his home, an experience that left a lasting mark on his heart. Despite the support of Maitha and Rawivah, the darkness within him persisted. Faycal now holds an unwavering wariness toward outsiders, yet cherishes the life he's carved out. His pledge is to grow strong and shield his newfound family, even if it demands everything he has.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/be3d172b61e52e39e0b3c5e6477ebb11be6a4dbb.png[/img]

In combat, Faycal is a dependable archer, granting you an array of long-range possibilities and opens up guerrilla tactics. Now, let’s explore the dynamic set of abilities he brings to the game:


- Movement skill: Rock-climbing
Upon activation, Faycal's mobility soars, allowing him to leap across chasms, climb up to higher vantage points, and cover more ground in a single turn. Bringing him on the team introduces new strategic options for both offense and evasion.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/e1fe9c86e20cce995c0f282fa37beffd658c7ad3.gif[/img]

- Alert shot skill: Safeguard the Sword of Convallaria
When activated, Faycal stands sentinel over a designated direction and area. Any intruding foes trigger automatic shots from Faycal, causing significant damage and interrupting their actions. This is a very strong defensive option to stop dangerous adversaries.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/24c6f7664fd3b23743ba9e54e6d6614cfb83e0ca.gif[/img]

- The Cloud-piercing Arrow
Faycal's premier single-target damage skill. The Cloud-Piercing Arrow is a "Curved Shot" that deftly bypasses numerous obstacles and terrains. Combining this skill with his rock-climbing prowess transforms Faycal into a highly mobile sniper for your team. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/1a99c06416ed6eb585fd48dd2b7390d44ed16b68.gif[/img]

This concludes our introduction to another compelling member of the Sword of Convallaria. We trust this sneak peek has ignited your curiosity to explore Faycal's potential and the tactical gameplay he brings to the table.

notes.title: Spring Release in the Works!
notes.content:
It’s been a wonderful two months since we shared our decision to launch Sword of Convallaria on all major platforms, and we’re overwhelmed by the amazing support from the Steam community and tactical RPG lovers around the world. We went through several rounds of closed betas, sat down with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2526380?emclan=103582791474034129&emgid=3659790810659684458]Famitsu[/url] and chatted with Yasumi Matsuno, and brought a playable PC demo to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2526380/view/3752118407961097859?l=english]Tokyo Game Show 2023[/url]. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/ecde3eea3abec37b3bdce5ff0eaefb28485de06a.png[/img]

[h2][b]What to expect in the next Spring[/b][/h2]
While the feedback we've received so far has been incredibly encouraging, there is still a substantial amount of work to be done before we can bring Sword of Convallaria to a global audience. We will concentrate on enhancing gameplay mechanics, optimizing performance, and refining the overall gaming experience as we aim for a [b]release in the upcoming spring[/b]. Here's a more detailed look of what we'll be focusing on during this extended development period:
[list]
[*] Enhanced PC experience: refining the user interface for PC, optimizing gameplay controls, and adding controller support, etc. 
[*] Localization excellence: rectifying improper translations and completing full-game localization for all supported languages to make for an accessible and enjoyable player experience.
[*] Optimizing the live service plan: We will work on optimizing the structure for the game, which will enable us to provide a consistent flow of fresh content after the game's initial release.
[*] And more!
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/4b0dc9e9a29dde9c33694746f7e1394a0b8de037.png[/img]
[i]Here are some early concept art of the church map[/i]

[h2][b]Future plans[/b][/h2]
With the spring release timeline, we should be able to prepare some more exciting content in the pipeline. While we can’t reveal all the details just yet, stay tuned for [b]potential surprises at the Steam Next Fest[/b] in 2024!

We’re tremendously grateful for your patience and understanding as we continue to work on Sword of Convallaria and attempt to deliver an authentic tactical RPG experience. We will be sharing more development updates and release info in future posts; please let us know in the comments what some of your favorite tactical RPG elements are and what you’d like to see in Sword of Convallaria at launch.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512721/f06b77687b4b23ec5c9f7bdbf923404be55d844b.jpg[/img]

To keep staying in the loop with Sword of Convallaria, don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist!
